big_idea.hypothesis: Hypothesis: ProofLaunch can help GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams pursue this outcome—one traceable path from a rights-bound brief to review-ready GTM artifacts—while addressing this problem—fragmented strategy, content, approval and measurement tools that slow execution and obscure accountability. Test that premise through this next step—review the end-to-end evidence pack and join the design-partner cohort—before scaling.
big_idea.organizing_idea: Make the decision inspectable: place owner-attested evidence claim-owner-001 before the ask, then invite the audience to challenge it. The zero-budget operating hypothesis is: create an expert utility, benchmark, teardown, or problem clinic that earns attention before a commercial ask
big_idea.testable_tension: Can GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams resolve fragmented strategy, content, approval and measurement tools that slow execution and obscure accountability under this constraint: No paid media: earn qualified action through product utility, evidence, founder expertise, communities or partners?
